title: Programme binding (.github/toolkit-programme.json), version 2
description: The repository's own Toolkit governance setting. Only the binding merged on the default branch counts, on every computer: a working tree, another branch or a fork's copy never does. Repository identity comes from the origin remote and GitHub; this file must agree and cannot override it. Child issues come from native sub-issues, never from the binding. Version 1 bindings are still read, as enabled with one parent.

parent_lifecycle.description: Explicit authority for the fenced refresh to repair and complete only the bound parent using every native descendant. Absence grants no lifecycle writes.

detach_finished_children.description: Standing owner permission for the controller's reconcile and sweep to unlink a closed COMPLETED or RETIRED task from its native parent once no open sub-issue, unfinished catalogued task or open PR needs it there. Nothing is closed or deleted, the catalogue keeps the task and the parent's private sidecar records each detach. Absent or false grants no detach.

governance.description: enabled turns Toolkit's GitHub governance on for this repository; disabled keeps it off, and only an owner-merged pull request changes it.

parents.description: The programme parent issues. The first is the one the reconciler records against. List one parent only for now: with a second, a task under a sub-issue of that programme could still be moved across programmes until a planning gate rules on descendants.

kind.description: The store backend. The only kind is github: a separate private repository written through the Contents API.

repository.description: A separate private repository; verified private and writable before every pass.

required_checks.description: Check names that count as required at the PR head, in addition to the checks GitHub marks required. With none of either, checks are never GREEN.

paid_security.description: Deprecated. Toolkit never turns on a GitHub feature that needs billing: off or on is accepted and ignored.

dependency_updates.description: How Dependabot updates are merged, as in version 1. Only the binding merged on the default branch counts.

task_prs.description: The repository's task switches, read by every app and the Projects controller. auto_merge: after-gates lets a finished task pull request merge once its gates pass; off, or no key, waits for a typed merge. merge_train: on, or no key, lets ready pull requests land as merge trains; off lands each alone. Both count only while governance is enabled. Only the owner changes them, by merging a binding pull request.

ci_shards.description: The owner's answer to the sharded CI offer that governance enable and refresh make: yes copies the sharded test workflow and Shard Timings into this repository, not-now asks again at the next refresh, never stops asking. This release only reads the key; nothing acts on it yet.

projection.description: Where the Programme Graph goes on the parent issue page, as in version 1.

schedule_folder.description: The Windows Task Scheduler folder for this repository's no-AI Toolkit tasks, such as TOOLKIT for the TOOLKIT folder. When left out it is the repository name in capitals, with dots and underscores turned into hyphens.

state.description: The public state branch: parent and child documents live on this branch of the bound repository, as public views (no private part, sessions only as hashes). The private store stays required beside it for the journals, the private sidecars and the checkpoint. Added by programme.cjs migrate-state; without it the documents stay in the private store.
